questions.question: A colleague rolls their eyes at an idea. Which horseman is this?
questions.answer: Contempt. It is the most serious of the four.

questions.question: How can you raise a concern without criticising the person?
questions.answer: Raise the concern gently. Use "I" to explain how a specific behaviour affects you. Avoid judging the person.

questions.question: How is a time-out different from stonewalling?
questions.answer: With stonewalling, you leave without a word and the other person feels ignored. For a time-out, say you need a few minutes to think. Then return to the conversation.
